cohort: A total of 284 pregnant women receiving antenatal care at King Faisal Hospital in Kigali, Rwanda, were enrolled between May 2023 and April 2024.
finding: Gestational diabetes (GD) was significantly associated with increased risks of several maternal adverse outcomes (pre-eclampsia, gestational hypertension, polyhydramnios, postpartum haemorrhage) and neonatal complications (hypoglycaemia, NICU admission, macrosomia), with specific risk factors identified for the development of GD itself.
mod_finding: Women diagnosed with gestational diabetes had a significantly higher risk of caesarean delivery (aRR 4.9; 95% CI 1.6 to 9.1).
